$schema_purpose: Defines the full JSON shape that the agent pipeline produces per email. Composed of: input metadata snapshot + LLM output (classification + extraction) + validator output + audit + retrieval + routing + output + guardrails + logs. This is the canonical record persisted to SQLite (agent_results.full_output_json) and returned by the API.

block_descriptions.input_metadata: Snapshot of selected fields from the emails table. Self-contains the record for API/dashboard use without joining.
block_descriptions.llm_output: Produced by the Classifier+Extractor Agent. Pure description of the email. See llm_output_schema.json.
block_descriptions.validator: Produced by the Validator Agent. Critique/verification of the llm_output. validation_result in {confirmed, flagged}. flagged_fields lists JSON paths the validator disputes (e.g., 'extraction.guest.guest_name'). revised_confidence is the validator's confidence floor; the router uses min(classification.confidence, validator.revised_confidence) for thresholding.
block_descriptions.audit: Produced by the Audit Agent. audit_finding in {clean, missing_fields, suspected_error, n/a} per taxonomy.json. missing_fields and inconsistencies are JSON paths into llm_output.extraction. risk_flags is a list of named flags (e.g., 'requires_internal_system_access', 'payment_topic_with_no_amount').
block_descriptions.routing: Produced by the Router Agent. Decisions derived from llm_output + validator + audit + (optional) retrieval. applied_rule_id references the matched rule in routing_rules.json.
block_descriptions.retrieval: Produced by the RAG Agent (conditional). used=false when RAG was skipped. sources is a list of {source_id, source_title, source_url_or_path, chunk_text, score}.
block_descriptions.output: Produced by the Output Generator Agent. Only one of the four output forms is populated per email; others remain null/empty. internal_notes is a free-form note for the human reviewer (not customer-facing).
block_descriptions.guardrails: Produced by the Guardrails Agent. passed=false blocks the output and forces escalation. blocked_claims is a list of {claim_text, rule_id, reason}.
block_descriptions.logs: Pipeline metadata. agent_path is the ordered list of agent names that executed (e.g., ['preprocessor','classifier_extractor','validator','audit','router','output_generator','guardrails']). errors is a list of {agent_name, error_type, message, retry_count}.
